method.third_detector_semantics: All supplied images included; ETD and SE names recorded separately, without assuming equivalent detector settings
method.third_channel_key: ETD is the internal pair key; third_detector_name and source path identify whether the file is ETD or SE
method.input: Native first intensity channel; central 80% of rows; every column
method.gradient_preparation: Gaussian sigma1 native pixels, antialiased resizing, Gaussian gradient magnitude sigma0.7 reduced pixels
method.registration_estimator: skimage phase_cross_correlation, upsample_factor10; phase-normalised global and three full-height horizontal thirds, plus unnormalised global cross-check
method.threshold_scope: Descriptive manual-review trigger, not a validated alignment tolerance
method.limitations: Cross-detector contrast changes can move or obscure peaks. Downsampling limits sensitivity to small/local shifts. Matching geometry is plausible only after visual review; estimated shifts are not proof of misalignment.
